FIELDS.NAME: Creamy Delights Dairy Bar
FIELDS.GL CODE: REJECTED: Fire hazard due to cooking on premises without a fire suppression system.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Creamy Delights Dairy Bar, we specialize in serving a wide variety of premium ice cream flavors, dairy-based beverages, and related desserts. Our business operates with a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. We maintain strict adherence to food safety regulations by implementing comprehensive training programs for all staff to ensure they are knowledgeable about safe food handling practices.

To enhance our customers’ experience, we offer a cozy ambiance and friendly service, encouraging repeat visits from our community. All products are made with high-quality, sourced ingredients, and we are progressing towards a more comprehensive ingredient labeling and allergen disclosure policy to ensure that our customers are well-informed about what they consume.

We operate a clean and well-maintained environment, performing regular equipment maintenance and cleaning to mitigate any operational hazards. As we do not conduct cooking on the premises, we do not require a fire suppression system. Our hours of operation are designed to meet the needs of our local clientele, ensuring accessibility throughout the week.

Our Dairy & Ice Cream Shop features a cozy café area where we prepare and cook freshly made waffle cones and hot fudge desserts for our customers.
